name: Haneken
body:
Aura moderate transmutation; CL 7th; Slot none; Price 20,000 gp; Weight 2 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This unnaturally light katana has a length of 51 inches, from sword tip to pommel. Its pommel and collar are gold and its hilt is wrapped with red silk. Fine feathers are etched along the length of the blade. Haneken functions as a +2 katana which, because of its light weight, may be used in conjunction with Weapon Finesse. So long as you grip Haneken’s hilt, you gain a +10 bonus to all Acrobatic checks made to jump and are considered to be under the effects of feather fall.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor, feather fall; Cost 10,000 gp.
